slice: Exact-artifact red team of the Heimerdinker Workshop-to-Werkle next-decision stake.
sharedContext: The proposed feature is a compact Where this work lives readout directly below the signed-in header and at the first decision block.
It exposes exactly one stage and one next decision: Your Workshop, Match Deck, Possible Werkle, or Existing Werkle on this device.
Live boundary: This tells you which room you are in. It does not mean another person responded, agreed, paid, or joined a company.
It derives only from route plus validated device-local artifacts and cannot create account, partner, provider, membership, production, or release state.
Controls use explicit verbs and destinations: Improve My Workshop, Compare Matches, Continue This Possible Werkle, Review the Saved Brief.
Acceptance covers empty state, Match Deck, candidate-only Formation, valid local Operating Brief, corrupt/stale invalidation, standard member header, 390px overflow, and forbidden custody claims.
knownGaps: The artifact must not add another confusing header or duplicate existing navigation.
The four stages must be mutually exclusive under hostile local state.
